old_caption: The video showcases a close-up view of a dessert placed on a clear glass plate against a light gray or off-white background. The dessert appears to be a chocolate-covered pancake or crepe, featuring a light-colored, soft, porous base topped with a generous drizzle of liquid chocolate sauce. Colorful sprinkles are scattered across the top, partially submerged. A single white candle is inserted into the base, leaning at an angle. The chocolate sauce is liquid and actively pooling and spreading. The sprinkles appear to be shifting slightly with the liquid. The overall scene is not static, with the liquid and candle in motion.
original_wisa_caption: The video showcases a close-up view of a dessert placed on a clear glass plate against a plain white background. The dessert appears to be a chocolate-covered ice cream sundae, featuring a scoop of vanilla ice cream topped with a generous drizzle of chocolate sauce. Colorful sprinkles are scattered across the top, adding a festive touch. A single white candle is inserted into the ice cream, standing upright. As the video progresses, the chocolate sauce begins to melt, creating a glossy sheen over the ice cream. The melting process is gradual, with the chocolate spreading slightly outward from the center. The sprinkles remain intact but start to shift slightly due to the melting effect. The overall scene remains static, focusing solely on the dessert and its transformation as the chocolate melts.
caption: The video showcases a clear glass dish resting on a white surface, holding a round tan-rimmed object that floats in a shallow pool of liquid. The top of the object is coated in dark brown icing scattered with multicolored rod-shaped sprinkles in pink, green, blue, yellow, orange and white, while a single red sprinkle sits at the lower-right edge. A greenish-yellow oily film spreads across the liquid around darker brown patches. Near the upper-left of the icing stands a thin white stick topped with a small spiral coil. Throughout the clip this stick slowly leans and rotates, its coil tilting progressively toward the left while its base remains anchored in the icing. The surrounding sprinkles, the red sprinkle and the tan rim hold their positions. The oil-film boundary shifts only marginally. The camera stays fixed, so the gradual tilt of the white spiral stick is the dominant visible change.
